high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post from the user "spaceroxc." The post provides information about the Chicxulub Crater, which is the site of impact from the asteroid that killed the dinosaurs 66 million years ago. Text Content: The main text reads: "The site of impact from the asteroid that killed the dinosaurs 66 million years ago is called Chicxulub Crater." Below this, additional information states: "It has a diameter of 150 km and a depth of about 20 km."
